full_description:
Subject: Request to Provide Trainers for Training Courses in N’Djamena, Chad

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

We are Perfect Training Centre, based in Benghazi, Libya, and we are currently looking for qualified trainers based in Chad to deliver a series of training courses in N’Djamena, Chad, during August.

We kindly request WenakLabs to provide qualified trainers to deliver the following training courses:

1. Causes of Terrorism and the Factors Leading to Sympathy with It


2. Media and Television Message Development in the Field of Combating Extremism and Terrorism


3. Risks of Terrorism Financing, Money Laundering, and Methods of Combating Them


4. Capacity Building for Preparing Strategies to Combat Terrorism



Each course will be delivered over a period of five days, and the courses are expected to be conducted consecutively during August, according to an agreed schedule.

The training will be held in one of the well-known hotels in N’Djamena, and each course will be delivered to one group of 30 to 40 participants, with an initial expected number of 30 participants.

The daily training time will be from 09:00 AM to 02:00 PM.

Please note that Perfect Training Centre will be responsible for providing and arranging the following:

1. Training venue at the hotel.


2. Training materials, course outlines, and training methodology.


3. Presentation and training equipment.


4. Coffee break for the participants.


5. Lunch for the participants.



Accordingly, the role of the trainers will be to attend the training venue in N’Djamena and deliver the assigned courses. The course outlines and training methodology will be prepared and submitted by us, and the trainers’ professional review, feedback, and comments will be highly appreciated.

Kindly provide us with your comprehensive lump-sum financial offer in USD for providing qualified trainers to deliver the above-mentioned courses. The offer should be final and inclusive of all trainers’ professional fees and expenses related to their participation, including:

1. Professional fees for delivering each course for five days.


2. Preparation time and review of the course outlines and methodology.


3. Local transportation to and from the training venue in N’Djamena.


4. Any personal or professional expenses related to the trainers’ participation.


5. Any other costs related to the trainers’ attendance and delivery of the courses.



The submitted financial offer should be comprehensive, lump-sum, and final, with no additional financial claims afterward.

We also kindly request you to provide us with the following:

1. CVs/profiles of the proposed trainers.


2. Relevant previous experience for each trainer.


3. Confirmation of availability during August.


4. Proposed assignment of trainers for each course.


5. Your final financial offer in USD for each course and/or for the full package.



Thank you for your cooperation, and we look forward to receiving your proposal at the earliest convenience.

Best regards,

Mohamed Omar
Perfect Training Centre
Benghazi, Libya
Phone / WhatsApp: +218 92 510 8921

full_description:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer to design and deploy a secure, scalable, multi-tenant SMTP Gateway on AWS that integrates with Microsoft 365 Exchange Online using Exchange Online Connectors.
The SMTP Gateway will become part of our Enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solution and will process outbound emails for multiple enterprise customers.
Project Overview
Enterprise customers will configure Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Outbound Connectors to route their outgoing emails through our SMTP Gateway hosted on AWS.
The SMTP Gateway will:
• Accept secure SMTP connections from Microsoft 365 Exchange Online.
• Identify the customer (tenant) based on connector configuration, sender domain, certificate, or other recommended mechanism.
• Receive the complete email over TLS.
• Submit the email to our DLP application for security inspection.
• Obtain a synchronous allow/block decision from the DLP engine during the SMTP transaction (before issuing the final SMTP response).
• If approved, relay the email securely to its intended destination.
• If blocked, reject the SMTP transaction with the appropriate SMTP response so that Microsoft 365 generates a standard Non-Delivery Report (NDR) to the sender.
• Maintain SMTP queues, logs, monitoring, and retry mechanisms.
• Support multiple enterprise customers through a secure multi-tenant architecture.
The solution should be modular and designed so that Google Workspace integration can be added in the future.
Scope of Work
• Deploy a dedicated AWS EC2 instance.
• Install and configure a production-grade SMTP Gateway (Postfix preferred, but open to recommendations).
• Configure secure SMTP relay.
• Configure Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Connectors.
• Configure TLS certificates and secure SMTP communication.
• Configure DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, PTR, etc.) where required.
• Recommend and implement the appropriate DKIM strategy (preserve existing signatures where possible or perform per-tenant DKIM signing if required) while maintaining SPF, DKIM, and DMARC compliance.
• Configure message queues and retry mechanisms.
• Configure logging, monitoring, health checks, and troubleshooting tools.
• Secure the SMTP Gateway against unauthorized access, abuse, and open relay vulnerabilities.
• Integrate the SMTP Gateway with our DLP application through an API, local service, milter/content filter, or another recommended approach.
• Provide complete deployment documentation and architecture diagrams.
• Assist with end-to-end testing using Microsoft 365.
Architecture Expectations
The proposed solution should include:
• Secure multi-tenant architecture.
• Tenant identification and configuration management.
• Synchronous DLP inspection during the SMTP session.
• High availability and future horizontal scalability.
• Secure storage of tenant configuration and secrets.
• Comprehensive logging, monitoring, and auditing.
• Modular architecture for future Google Workspace support.
Required Skills
• AWS EC2
• Linux Administration (Ubuntu or Amazon Linux)
• Postfix (preferred) or equivalent SMTP Gateway
• SMTP, ESMTP, TLS and email routing
• Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Connectors
• Email security best practices
• DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, PTR)
• Queue management and monitoring
• Experience building secure email gateways or similar email infrastructure
Good to Have
• Experience integrating SMTP gateways with DLP or Secure Email Gateway (SEG) products.
• Experience with Google Workspace SMTP routing.
• Experience designing scalable or highly available SMTP infrastructure on AWS.
• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
Deliverables
• Production-ready SMTP Gateway deployed on AWS.
• Secure integration with Microsoft 365 Exchange Online.
• Integration interface with our DLP engine.
• Multi-tenant architecture capable of supporting multiple enterprise customers.
• Deployment documentation.
• Architecture diagram.
• Successful end-to-end testing.
• Knowledge transfer session.
While Applying, Please Include
• Brief introduction.
• Relevant SMTP Gateway / Email Security projects completed.
• Experience with Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Connectors.
• Your proposed solution architecture.
• Which SMTP Gateway software you recommend (Postfix, Exim, Haraka, etc.) and why.
• How you would implement the synchronous DLP inspection workflow.
• How you would design the multi-tenant architecture, including tenant identification, configuration storage, per-tenant policies, and scalability.
• Whether you recommend a database and what it would be used for.
• Your recommended DKIM strategy for a multi-tenant deployment.
• Your recommended Exchange Online connector configuration (TLS partner connector, certificate-based authentication, IP-based authentication, etc.) and the rationale.
• How you would approach IP reputation management and tenant isolation as the platform scales.
• Estimated timeline.
• Expected budget.
• Availability for post-deployment support.
Confidentiality
This project involves enterprise email security infrastructure and may process sensitive customer email data. Shortlisted candidates will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) .

Report civic issues
Upload photos and videos
Mark the exact GPS location
Discover nearby reported issues

Real-life situations

Marks the exact GPS location.
Opens the map.

full_description:
We are seeking an experienced A/V Technician to set up, operate, and monitor the sound system for the 10th Annual Toronto Carnival Run, an outdoor community event held along Toronto's waterfront.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in live outdoor events who is comfortable troubleshooting equipment and ensuring clear, reliable sound throughout the event.

Event Details

Event: Toronto Carnival Run 2026
Date: Saturday, July 25, 2026
Location: Sir Casimir Gzowski Park, Toronto, ON
Hours: 6:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Responsibilities

* Set up and test the complete PA sound system before the event begins
* Connect and configure mixer/amplifier, speakers, monitor, and microphones
* Perform sound checks with the MC and event staff
* Operate the sound system throughout the event
* Adjust microphone and music volume levels as needed
* Start, stop, and manage background music from a provided iPad playlist
* Troubleshoot any audio issues during the event
* Tear down and pack equipment following the event

Equipment

The sound system will include:

* Mixer/amplifier
* Four (4) full-range PA speakers on speaker stands
* Stage monitor
* Cordless microphones
* Corded microphones
* Hands-free/headset microphone
* iPad with preloaded background music playlist

Qualifications

* Experience operating sound systems for live events
* Familiarity with PA systems, mixers, microphones, and speakers
* Ability to troubleshoot audio issues quickly
* Reliable, organized, and able to work independently
* Must arrive on time and be available for the entire event

Preferred

* Experience with outdoor festivals, races, concerts, or community events
* Own transportation to and from the event site

To Apply

Please include:

* A brief summary of your live event audio experience
* Examples of similar events you've supported
* Your availability for Saturday, July 25, 2026
* Your proposed rate (hourly or fixed price)

We're looking for someone who is dependable, professional, and can help deliver a seamless audio experience for participants, volunteers, entertainers, and guests throughout this milestone event.
